wage_reference.name: GGMMI / RMMMG
wage_reference.note: Belgian national minimum wage reference for full-time private-sector employees. Sectoral minima may be higher.

social_security.employee_contribution_note: Standard employee ONSS contribution rate for private-sector employees.
social_security.employer_contribution_note: Base employer contribution rate for the private market sector before reductions.

structural_reduction.source: ONSS / RSZ administrative instructions 2026/2, structural reduction, category 1
structural_reduction.note: Prototype full-time monthly implementation. The quarterly reference wage S is approximated as gross monthly wage multiplied by 3. Negative components are set to zero.

structural_reduction_category_2.source: ONSS / RSZ administrative instructions 2026/2, structural reduction, category 2 (secteur non-marchand / Maribel social), https://www.socialsecurity.be/employer/instructions/dmfa/fr/latest/instructions/deductions/structuralreduction_targetgroupreductions/structuralreduction.html
structural_reduction_category_2.note: Prototype full-time monthly implementation. Formula: base + low_wage_component_rate x (low_wage_threshold - S) + very_low_wage_component_rate x (very_low_wage_threshold - S) + high_wage_component_rate x (S - high_wage_threshold), each term floored at 0 before summing (same convention as category 1). IMPORTANT SIMPLIFICATION: the official formula's high-wage term uses W, the employer's total quarterly payroll mass (masse salariale trimestrielle) -- a firm-level aggregate specific to the Maribel social funding mechanism, not the individual worker's own wage. Since this module simulates a single representative employee rather than a firm, W is approximated as equal to S (this employee's own quarterly wage), the same single-employee simplification already used throughout this module. This is a best-effort implementation of a structurally complex, firm-level formula; category 2 results should be treated as indicative.

limits: Personal income tax and withholding tax are not simulated in this V1.

The structural reduction is simulated for category 1 (general private sector) and category 2 (secteur non-marchand / Maribel social) using a simplified full-time monthly implementation. Category 2's high-wage component depends on the employer's total payroll mass in the official formula; this module approximates it with the single simulated employee's own wage, since no firm-level aggregate is modeled.
The quarterly reference wage S is approximated as monthly gross wage multiplied by 3.
Sectoral minimum wages are not simulated.
Sector-specific employer contributions are not simulated.
Manual-worker holiday pay contributions are not simulated.
Regional and family-status differences are not simulated.
Employer contribution rate is treated as a simplified base rate before structural reduction.
